title.zh: 酱油的三段：制曲、酱醪、加热
title.en: Soy sauce in three stages: koji, moromi, heating

description.zh: 两三天养曲霉，几个月让盐水里的乳酸菌和酵母接力，最后几十分钟加热；时间轴上的点由后面的模型算出。
description.en: Two to three days of mould, months of a bacteria-to-yeast relay in brine, then minutes of heating; the timeline points come from the later models.

en: how long does soy sauce ferment

title.en: Koji: growing a batch of enzymes

description.zh: 曲霉长在蒸黄豆和炒小麦上，两三天造出蛋白酶和淀粉酶；生长放热，曲床太厚不翻就超过 40 °C。逻辑斯谛生长加热量平衡的模型。
description.en: Koji mould grows on steamed soybeans and roasted wheat and makes proteases and amylases in two to three days; growth releases heat and a thick unturned bed passes 40 °C. Logistic growth with a heat balance.

description.zh: 黄豆给蛋白质，小麦给淀粉和糖；按比例算出的糖决定后面的酵母吃不吃得饱。溜酱油、浓口、中式 80:20 与 70:30 的比较。
description.en: Soybeans bring protein, wheat brings starch and sugar; the sugar the ratio provides decides whether the yeast later has enough to eat. Tamari, koikuchi and Chinese 80:20 and 70:30 compared.

title.zh: 盐水里的接力：乳酸菌和酵母
title.en: The relay in brine: lactic bacteria then yeast

description.zh: 嗜盐四联球菌先产酸把 pH 拉到 5 以下，鲁氏接合酵母才能在浓盐里接棒产酒精和香气；在模型里，盐超过约 20.6% 或温度太低，接力就失败。
description.en: Tetragenococcus halophilus acidifies the mash below pH 5 so that Zygosaccharomyces rouxii can take over in strong brine and make ethanol and aroma; in the model, above about 20.6% salt or in the cold the relay fails.

description.zh: 氨基酸和糖的美拉德反应生成类黑精；阿伦尼乌斯方程换算加热、室温和冰箱的差别，结论取决于在酱油上还没测准的活化能。开瓶后变深还和氧化有关。
description.en: The Maillard reaction between amino acids and sugars makes melanoidins; the Arrhenius equation compares heating, room temperature and the fridge, and the answer hinges on an activation energy not yet measured for soy sauce. Oxidation also darkens an opened bottle.

zh: 酱油开封后为什么变黑
en: does soy sauce need to be refrigerated

title.en: Where soy sauce aroma comes from

description.zh: 酵母带来酒精、HEMF 和 3-甲硫基丙醇，念珠菌把小麦的酚类变成 4-乙基愈创木酚，加热生成呋喃酮。
description.en: Yeast brings ethanol, HEMF and methionol, Candida turns wheat phenolics into 4-ethylguaiacol, and heating forms furanones.

title.zh: 氨基酸态氮：瓶子上的数字
title.en: Amino-acid nitrogen: the number on the bottle

description.zh: 甲醛滴定数的是游离氨基，加进去的谷氨酸钠和铵盐也会被数进去；GB/T 18186 的特级到三级，2025 版的铵盐上限 28%，以及日本 JAS 按总氮分级。
description.en: Formol titration counts free amino groups, so added sodium glutamate and ammonium count too; the GB/T 18186 grades, the 28% ammonium cap in the 2025 edition, and Japan's JAS grades by total nitrogen.

title.zh: 酿半年和做几天：酿造酱油、低盐固态和酸水解
title.en: Six months or a few days: brewed, low-salt solid-state and acid-hydrolysed

description.zh: 高盐稀态走完整个接力；低盐固态更快；酸水解几天切完蛋白质、会生成 3-MCPD，在中国现行规定下不能叫酱油（GB 2717-2018 和市场监管总局 2021 年公告；3-MCPD 限量见 GB 2762-2025）。
description.en: High-salt liquid brewing runs the whole relay; low-salt solid-state is faster; acid hydrolysis breaks protein in days and forms 3-MCPD, and under current Chinese rules may not be called soy sauce.

title.en: Why soy sauce is so salty

description.zh: 浓盐水是酿造条件的一部分；日本几种酱油每 100 克含钠约 5.1–6.3 克，淡口比浓口更咸。只讲含量和机制。
description.en: Strong brine is part of the brewing; about 5.1–6.3 g sodium per 100 g in Japanese styles, and usukuchi is saltier than koikuchi. Content and mechanism only.

en: why is soy sauce so salty

label.en: Wheat sugar feeds what comes next

reason.zh: 第 4 章的乳酸菌和酵母吃的是第 3 章小麦淀粉变成的糖；不加小麦，接力的后半段就没有多少原料。
reason.en: The lactic bacteria and yeast of chapter 4 live on the sugar that chapter 3’s wheat starch becomes; without wheat the second half of the relay has little to work on.

label.en: Sugar is half of the browning

reason.zh: 第 5 章的美拉德反应需要氨基酸和糖两样东西，糖来自第 3 章的小麦。
reason.en: The Maillard reaction of chapter 5 needs both amino acids and sugars, and the sugars come from chapter 3’s wheat.

reason.zh: 第 6 章说酱油有而腐乳没有的香气，一处来自第 4 章酵母在盐水里的那一段。
reason.en: Chapter 6 traces part of the aroma that soy sauce has and sufu lacks to the yeast stage of chapter 4.

reason.zh: 第 6 章的另一处香气来自压榨后的加热，和第 5 章让颜色变深的是同一类反应。
reason.en: The other source of aroma in chapter 6 is the heating after pressing, the same family of reactions that darkens the colour in chapter 5.

label.en: Saving time means skipping the relay

reason.zh: 第 8 章用第 4 章的接力模型看缩短时间的办法各自跳过了哪一段：低盐固态缩短了接力，酸水解完全不用微生物。
reason.en: Chapter 8 uses chapter 4’s relay model to show which stage each shortcut skips: low-salt solid-state shortens the relay, and acid hydrolysis uses no microbes at all.
